Bank Perekonomian Rakyat Bintan is an Indonesian rural bank, known as a Bank Perkreditan Rakyat or BPR, operating in the Bintan regency of Riau Islands province, Indonesia. It provides basic financial services including savings, deposits, and credit facilities primarily to local communities, small businesses, and micro-enterprises. As a rural bank, it operates under supervision of the Indonesian Financial Services Authority, OJK, serving the local economy.
